data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Nur' meaning 'light'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the inner light that guides one's spiritual journey towards enlightenment and wisdom. The name Nurani carries the meaning “Light, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nurani usually hope their child will grow to embody light, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
